title: Flurry Cucumber: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Flurry Cucumber: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Flurry cucumber is a cucumber variety from Upjohn. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Flurry is a registered cucumber variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1987. Upjohn bred it. It takes 38 to 40 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 15.32 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 38 to 40 days from sowing to the first harvest.
**Yield:** 15.32 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Flurry cucumber takes 38 to 40 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is about the average of the 5 cucumber varieties with a day count, 39.2 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 15.32 t/ha trails the average of its group, 25. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cucumber fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Flurry cucumber

Cucumber gives its first fruit fast, often in five to six weeks. Pick a variety bred to tolerate downy mildew if you plant near the rains. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 38 to 40 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 15.32 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Flurry?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
